verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on per-domain auto-renew controls, renewal or expiry reminder notices, or post-expiry grace and redemption windows. The nearby evidence is adjacent only: a WHOIS Watchlist to "monitor expiry or status changes" (no notifications to the admin are documented), API renewal commands (one-off manual renewals, not an auto-renew setting), and grace deletions for domain tasting (returning a new registration, not recovering a lapsed one).

support.subject: As an IT admin, renewals never surprise me — auto-renew controls per domain, expiry notices, and documented grace/redemption windows if something lapses
